descriptive_results.scope: All twenty retained selected checkpoints. fixed_large seed 6503 is from a separate post-hoc audit of a failed attempt; that audit does not restore the registered campaign. Intervals describe these checkpoint predictions and are not a valid completed-campaign confirmation. Five initialization seeds share one frozen dataset; they are not five independent task-family draws.

deviations.campaign_continuation: The script stopped at failed attempt 18. The two remaining registered arm/seed attempts ran once with unchanged original source; each passed normal replay. No replacement for the failed attempt.
deviations.implementation_repairs: Live filesystem accounting raced atomic CURRENT publication; CI separately exposed the same race during Cargo temporary-file removal. Both affected samplers now tolerate disappearing entries only during live scans and require strict post-exit inventories.
deviations.posthoc_audit: Existing failed-attempt outputs only; 966 additional case executions, zero fitting updates. Original failed status preserved.

failed_attempt_audit.scope: Post-hoc inference, validation-objective and six retained-state checks. No retraining, replacement attempt, or fabricated final budget/timing/restart record.

hosted_verification.scope: Repaired implementation, contracts, native tests/fixtures, and harness replay. Optional learning is not rerun in hosted CI.

outcome.formal_summary_refusal: incomplete representation campaign cannot yield a research decision

post_experiment_repairs.chronology: All twenty attempts and the partial audit used the original experiment source. Repairs came afterward; no scientific settings, checkpoints or original manifests were changed. Replay historical EXP-0004 with commit 293a9578f9ed5a700be3d4d6e43a7308d1fbe598.

gradients.scope: sampled entries across all conditional parameter tensors, synthetic smooth loss

preflight.scope: development throughput and implementation checks only

resources.nominal_scope: Forward and training counts are declared proxies, not measured hardware FLOPs. Recorded native totals include construction, conversion, ordinary/diagnostic/intervention execution and available persistence receipts; unrecorded work at the interruption is unknown. No zero cost is imputed for missing evidence.
resources.timing_scope: One observation per completed run; wall time includes framework startup, validation, copying, state operations and evidence. Failed final timing is unavailable. No latency or efficiency conclusion.
